about_the_game:
In this DEMO you will learn the core puzzle type and start your escape! Progress can be continued in the FULL VERSION, where Steam Achievements and Leaderboards are unlocked.

*****

Explore and solve your way through the gloomy halls in which you find yourself stuck. Thinking symmetrically will be key! Isolated and environmental puzzles feature in this (almost) pure puzzle experience.

Explore the halls to find puzzles blocking your progress. They might be simple, in-your-face, puzzles or more subtle puzzles which involve the environment around you.

Progress further, and understand the layout as you begin your escape.

Key Features in the DEMO

  • Learn the mechanics behind core puzzle types.

  • Isolated and environmental symmetry-based puzzles.

  • A gloomy retro-inspired aesthetic.

  • Plays GREAT on SteamDeck.

More in the FULL VERSION

  • Branching paths and more clues about how to escape.

  • Steam Achievements and Leaderboards.

  • About 1.5h / 3h gameplay for most players to escape / 100% the game.
